claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show a readable ratings label or any text confirming 650W or 144 cells or Canadian origin.

risks.risk: Wattage/cell count may not match the claimed 650W/144 cells (could be a different size/rating).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the panel’s ratings label (sticker) showing Wp, Voc, Isc, and model/serial.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used solar panel with unknown rating (worst-case: treat as lower output than claimed).

risks.risk: Performance degradation or hidden damage (microcracks, hot spots) not visible in the single wide shot.
risks.proof: Seller provides an IV curve/test report or at least a working measurement: Voc and Isc under sun (or a multimeter reading with clear conditions).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed to meet nameplate performance (worst-case: treat as reduced output).

risks.risk: Junction box/diodes/cables may be faulty or have loose connections.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the junction box and cable entry, plus a photo showing the panel connected and producing power (or continuity test).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing basic checks/possible repair risk.

risks.risk: Frame/laminate condition (water ingress, delamination) may be present but not obvious from the angle.
risks.proof: Edge close-ups (corners and backsheet) and a photo of the back side.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with potential cosmetic/structural wear.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the ratings label/sticker (Wp, Voc, Isc, cell count, model/serial).
Photo of the junction box and the cable/connector end (close-up).
Back-side photo of the panel (to check for delamination/water marks).
Any test proof: IV curve or measured Voc/Isc (with time/date and sunlight conditions).
response.reason: The photo shows a used solar panel, but the key pricing drivers (exact wattage/cell count and condition/performance) are not readable or verifiable from the provided image. Request the ratings label and a simple performance test before pricing.
